Nov. 21 falls in standard time, and the source times read 7:18 AM EST and 7:17 AM EST. 2) Quarterback section: 'Both say Johnson, a 40-year-old veteran' is unsupported. Only NFL.com gives his age; CBS Sports calls him a 'journeyman veteran.' Also, 'fourth different starter in a short span' blurs the outlets' differing counts: CBS says fourth in five weeks, NFL.com says fourth in four weeks. Attribute each count to its outlet. 3) 'As of our check, Arizona had not announced a Sunday starter' needs a stated Eastern time, for example 'As of 7:18 AM EST Saturday.' 4) Matchup section: 'The excerpt does not tell us...' describes how the article was produced. Rephrase as what the CBS Sports report does not say. 5) Model section: 'saved background with no current price or expected value attached' is internal workflow wording. Rephrase for readers, for example 'it is a projection, not a price.' 6) Countercase: 'a unanimous 40.5-41 market' is self-contradictory because books split between 40.5 and 41. Use 'tight' or 'consistent' instead. 7) Market section: 'a tight consensus... all listed the total at 40.5' is accurate, but it omits Bovada, which also listed 40.5 at the 7:17 AM EST snapshot and was at 41 in the 8:37 PM EST Friday snapshot. 'No change in the median line' is still correct as written. The market section also cites s1 and s3, which contain no market data.
